p1: Close-up portrait, head and shoulders fill the frame: an African woman in her thirties with braided hair tied back, long-sleeved white top and grey apron, puts on clear safety goggles over her eyes, bright tidy workshop, soft daylight.
p4: Medium close-up, waist-up framing, the subject fills most of the frame: an African woman in her thirties with braided hair tied back, wearing clear safety goggles, blue nitrile gloves, a long-sleeved white top and a grey apron, standing at a clean white tiled worktable in a bright tidy workshop, soft daylight. She stands ready behind the table with a large white plastic bucket and a clear measuring jug in front of her, and smiles.

m1: Tight top-down view, the table surface fills the whole frame: soap-making materials packed close together in neat rows, a white plastic bucket, a digital kitchen scale, a clear measuring jug, small bowls of white powder, a brown jerrycan, a tub of clear gel, a bag of salt, small bottles. Bright even daylight.
